descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

SEO today is very different from the SEO practiced eight years ago. Ranking a website is no longer limited to placing keywords, publishing routine articles, building backlinks, and preparing monthly reports.

People now discover information through Google Search, AI Overviews, conversational AI platforms, local search results, videos, social media platforms, and other answer-driven experiences. Search engines have become much better at understanding meaning, context, entities, expertise, user intent, and brand credibility.

At Webindia Master, we are looking for an SEO Executive who understands this evolution and wants to work at the intersection of traditional SEO, AI-powered search, and measurable business growth.

We need someone who can think beyond a standard SEO checklist. The ideal candidate should understand how customers search, why certain sources earn trust, and how to create strategies that improve visibility wherever people look for information.

This role is ideal for a curious, analytical, and growth-oriented professional who asks meaningful questions, challenges outdated practices, tests new ideas, and converts insights into measurable results.

We are not looking for someone who repeats the same SEO activities every month. We are looking for someone who can understand a business, identify genuine opportunities, and take ownership of its long-term organic growth.

Key Responsibilities

SEO and AI Search Strategy

  • Understand each client's business model, services, target audience, competitors, and commercial objectives before preparing an SEO strategy.
  • Develop strategies for visibility across traditional search, local search, rich results, and AI-generated search experiences.
  • Research search intent, conversational queries, customer questions, related entities, and every stage of the buyer journey.
  • Create topical maps and content clusters that build genuine subject authority instead of disconnected keyword-focused content.
  • Identify opportunities for clients to become trusted, useful, and authoritative sources for users, search engines, and AI platforms.
  • Monitor search algorithm updates, AI search developments, and changing user behavior.
  • Convert industry changes into practical experiments, recommendations, and implementation plans.
  • Develop customized SEO strategies for service-based businesses, e-commerce websites, local businesses, and international projects.

Research and Opportunity Discovery

  • Conduct detailed keyword, entity, topic, competitor, content gap, and SERP feature research.
  • Evaluate opportunities based on search intent, business relevance, competition, conversion potential, and commercial value.
  • Study competitor strategies to understand how they earn rankings, mentions, citations, backlinks, and authority.
  • Identify customer questions and content gaps that can be addressed through expert insights, case studies, original research, and practical examples.
  • Review customer reviews, online communities, forums, and sales feedback to understand real user language and concerns.
  • Identify emerging search trends before they become highly competitive.
  • Prioritize SEO opportunities based on expected business impact, implementation effort, and long-term value.

Content Strategy and Optimization

  • Prepare detailed content briefs covering target audience, search intent, page objectives, content structure, entities, supporting evidence, and desired user actions.
  • Collaborate with content writers and subject matter experts to create original, accurate, and user-focused content.
  • Improve existing content by enhancing clarity, structure, depth, internal linking, freshness, authorship, and trust signals.
  • Optimize page titles, headings, meta descriptions, images, anchor text, and website content naturally without keyword stuffing.
  • Plan service pages, landing pages, location pages, blogs, FAQs, comparison pages, and case studies.
  • Ensure published content delivers genuine value beyond what already exists on competing websites.
  • Create content that answers important customer questions while encouraging deeper website engagement.
  • Recommend whether outdated pages should be updated, merged, redirected, or removed.

Responsible Use of AI

  • Use AI tools to assist with research, topic discovery, content planning, workflow automation, and data analysis.
  • Apply human judgment, fact-checking, and editorial review to every AI-assisted output.
  • Verify facts, statistics, examples, and recommendations before publication.
  • Identify and improve generic, repetitive, or inaccurate AI-generated content through original expertise and research.
  • Build efficient AI-assisted workflows without compromising originality, quality, or brand voice.
  • Understand that AI supports strategic thinking but cannot replace human expertise.
  • Avoid relying on mass-generated, unverified AI content as an SEO strategy.

Technical SEO

  • Conduct technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexability, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, duplicate content, status codes, XML sitemaps, and robots directives.
  • Review website architecture, URL structures, crawl paths, internal linking, and orphan pages.
  • Identify mobile usability, page experience, and Core Web Vitals issues.
  • Understand how JavaScript rendering impacts crawling and indexing.
  • Coordinate with developers to explain issues, prioritize fixes, and verify implementations after deployment.
  • Recommend and validate structured data according to Schema.org and search engine guidelines.
  • Review pagination, faceted navigation, filtering, and crawl budget optimization for large and e-commerce websites.
  • Support Local SEO, E-commerce SEO, and International SEO initiatives, including hreflang implementation and regional targeting.
  • Monitor indexing behavior and investigate why important pages are not being crawled or indexed.
  • Support IndexNow implementation and other search engine discovery methods where appropriate.

Authority Building and Digital PR

  • Develop ethical, relevance-focused authority-building strategies instead of chasing a fixed number of backlinks.
  • Identify opportunities for expert contributions, partnerships, digital PR, citations, and authoritative industry mentions.
  • Evaluate backlink opportunities based on topical relevance, editorial quality, trust, traffic, and long-term value.
  • Monitor harmful, spammy, or irrelevant backlinks and recommend corrective action when necessary.
  • Strengthen the clients digital presence through consistent business, brand, and entity information.
  • Recognize that modern authority is built through expertise, trust, reputation, references, and genuine brand demand rather than backlinks alone.
  • Avoid outdated SEO practices such as low-quality directory submissions, automated backlinks, and spam comment links.

Analytics, Reporting, and Experimentation

  • Use Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Bing Webmaster Tools, and professional SEO platforms to monitor website performance.
  • Measure qualified organic traffic, non-brand visibility, conversions, enquiries, revenue contribution, rich-result coverage, and AI search visibility.
  • Prepare reports explaining what changed, why it changed, what was learned, and the recommended next steps.
  • Focus on meaningful insights instead of vanity metrics.
  • Communicate SEO performance honestly and transparently.
  • Create hypotheses and conduct controlled SEO experiments wherever practical.
  • Investigate ranking and traffic changes logically instead of assuming every fluctuation is algorithm-related.
  • Track implementation progress and follow up with content, development, project management, and client-facing teams until important recommendations are completed.
  • Connect SEO performance with real business outcomes such as leads, enquiries, sales, and revenue growth.

Key Skills

  • At least 2 years of practical experience managing SEO campaigns and websites.

You understand that the first three seconds can make or break a video. You know how to build a hook, create curiosity, maintain retention and make people want to watch till the end.

  • Working closely with Content and Marketing teams to conceptualize, storyboard and produce video content across social media, brand campaigns, podcasts and digital platforms.

You will lead and guide teams delivering Architecture Consulting Services, owning key deliverables such as design documents, migration plans, MoPs, test plans, and campus network best-practice recommendations.   • Implement and maintain robust security protocols and measures, including Access Control Lists (ACLs), Network Address Translation (NAT), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS).

Including but not limited to Guest Services, Trustsec, pxGrid and 3rd party integrations.
  • Troubleshoot complex network, security, and data center incidents, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective measures to restore services swiftly and prevent future occurrences.
  • Design, implement, and enforce security policies with Secure Access, including but not limited to VPN as a Service, Zero Trust Network Access, Secure Web Gateway, Cloud Access Security Broker, Data Loss Prevention, Firewall as a Service with IPS, Cloud Secure Malware Analytics, DNS-layer security, Secure Internet Access, Secure Private Access and Umbrella.

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field A minimum of 8-10 years of experience in network and security engineering with a strong focus on network security, firewalls and Network Access.

  • Other valuable certifications include ITIL Foundational, CISSP, Palo Alto PCNSE, or CompTIA Security+.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Cisco routing and switching technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VLANs, STP).
  • Strong understanding of security principles, including IDS/IPS, VPN (IPsec, SSL), encryption protocols, and endpoint security.
  • Experience with network monitoring, packet capture analysis (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump), and SIEM tools.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting languages such as Python and Ansible, and AI agents is a plus.
  • Knowledge of cloud networking concepts and hybrid cloud architectures, including AWS and Azure.
  • Ability to lead and mentor security network engineers, provide technical guidance, and foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive initiatives effectively.

We ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Mobile App Developer - Native Apps
jobDescription:
Youve shipped production apps. You know the difference between works and ships at scale. Youve optimised memory, debugged production crashes, and managed app store releases. Youre not building for a classroom - youre building for users.

This is a 6-month contract with a clear path to full-time if you deliver solid work and grow with the team.

What You Will Do
  • Design and build native or cross-platform mobile applications (iOS, Android, or React Native - bring your depth).
  • Own the full app lifecycle: architecture, development, testing, optimisation, and production support.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers on API contracts and data flow.
  • Optimise for performance: startup time, memory usage, battery efficiency, responsiveness.
  • Debug production issues with speed and precision using debuggers and profiling tools.
  • Manage app store deployments and handle release cycles.
  • Write clean, testable code that survives code review.
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.
What We Are Looking For
  • 2+ years of production experience building mobile applications (iOS native, Android native, or React Native - one deep expertise).
  • Expert-level proficiency in your primary stack: Swift/Kotlin for native, or JavaScript/TypeScript for React Native.
  • Hands-on experience with production app optimisation: memory profiling, startup time, battery efficiency.
  • Real debugging skills using DevTools, Xcode, or Android Studio to solve production crashes.
  • A published app on the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
  • Git workflow and team-based code review experience.
Good to Have
  • Experience with local storage, device APIs, and app permissions.
  • Familiarity with push notifications and deep linking.
  • Understanding of REST API integration and state management patterns.
  • Experience with CI/CD for mobile (GitHub Actions, Fastlane).
  • Backend notification services (Firebase Cloud Messaging).
  • Biometric authentication (fingerprint/face ID).
  • Offline-first architecture or data sync patterns.
  • Experience with app performance monitoring tools.
What You Will Work On
  • React Native: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, state management (Redux, Zustand), local storage, REST APIs.
  • iOS: Swift, UIKit or SwiftUI, CoreData, URLSession, Xcode debugging.
  • Android: Kotlin, Jetpack, Room database, Retrofit, Android Studio profiling.
  • You bring mastery in one stack. Well support you growing into the others.
Why Kuvaka
  • Your apps will run in production, used by real people in healthcare, manufacturing, and enterprise.
  • Youll work alongside senior engineers who ship clean code and care about quality.
  • Youll get exposure to AI integration, cloud infrastructure, and workflows across multiple industries.
  • Growth here is performance-based: developers who ship and own their work move quickly.
  • The contract-to-full-time path is genuine - we convert contractors who deliver.

Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a technically proficient software Test Engineer to test our Model-Based Development framework. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing requirements, designing comprehensive test cases, and developing a robust testing infrastructure, running tests, analyzing results and, where appropriate, analyzing the technical facts encountered. You will work extensively with XML/XSD-based models, build test projects, and use modern development environments to ensure high software quality and framework reliability.

Job Responsibilities

  • Requirement Analysis: Review upper-level requirements and specifications to design thorough, traceability-compliant test strategies

  • Test Case Development: Prepare, author, and execute detailed test cases and test procedures for model-based components.

  • Framework & Project Development: Design and develop comprehensive test projects and frameworks, applying strong coding skills to automate and streamline validation activities.

  • Model & Data Processing: Work closely with XML / XSD schemas to parse, validate, and manipulate model-driven data structures.

  • Unit Testing & Execution: Implement and run unit tests using the Cunit framework (mandatory) to verify individual software modules and functional behaviours.

  • Environment Configuration: Use tools such as VS Code and automation/build tool Apache ANT to configure, manage, and scale development and testing environments.

  • Technical Documentation: Produce clear, detailed documentation of test activities and results, including full traceability to requirements.

Mandatory Skills

  • Bachelor s or masters degree in computer science or related engineering discipline between 4 +8 Years of industry experience

  • Methodologies: Proven experience in Component-Based Modelling and Model Driven Architecture principles.

  • Good understanding of tasking: Solid knowledge of multitasking and concurrency in embedded systems, with the ability to design effective test cases, identify timing-related issues and validate correct task behavior under various conditions

  • Programming & Scripting: Strong hands-on coding skills in the C Language along with Linux

  • Data Standards: Solid understanding and working experience with XML / XSD data structures.

  • Testing Frameworks: Experience in writing and executing test suites

  • Build & Version Control: Familiarity with build automation tools such as ANT

  • Development Environments: Proficiency in using VS Code

  • Documentation: Proficiency in MarkDown and Asciidoc formats, along with experience in doc-as-code methodologies

Desired Skills

  • Exposure to regulated software development lifecycles (e.g., DO-178C, ISO 26262).

  • Exposure to test framework development

descriptionFromApi:
Youve built projects. You know React basics. Youve deployed something to the internet. But you havent shipped code that thousands of users depend on - until now.

This is a full-time role. Well expect you to grow fast, learn in production, and take ownership. Well also give you people to learn from and space to develop into a solid engineer.

Youll be uncomfortable sometimes. Thats the point. Discomfort is where growth happens.

What You Will Do
  • Work inside a delivery pod with senior engineers, backend developers, product managers, and designers.
  • Build React components, manage state, and handle API integration.
  • Implement responsive designs that work across devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and sprint cycles.
  • Debug issues and ship fixes.
  • Take feedback, iterate, and improve.
What We Are Looking For
  • Strong React fundamentals: Hooks (useState, useEffect, useCallback), functional components, component lifecycle.
  • Comfort with modern JavaScript (ES6+): arrow functions, destructuring, promises, async/await.
  • HTML and CSS proficiency: flexbox, grid, responsive layouts.
  • Ability to fetch data from APIs and integrate it into React components.
  • Git basics: clone, commit, push, pull - comfortable working in teams.
  • A shipped project (internship, portfolio, hackathon, or deployed app showing real code).
Good to Have
  • Experience managing component state with Context API or a state library.
  • Understanding of responsive design and mobile-first principles.
  • Familiarity with browser DevTools (debugging, network tab, console errors).
  • Basic testing exposure (Jest or React Testing Library).
  • Experience with TailwindCSS, styled-components, or similar.
  • Deployed a React app (Vercel, Netlify, or GitHub Pages).
  • Familiarity with Figma or basic design tool understanding.
  • Knowledge of performance optimisation (lazy loading, code splitting).
  • Previous experience in a team environment with code reviews and feedback.
What You Will Work On
  • Week 1-2: Shadow code, understand our architecture, deploy a small feature.
  • Week 3-4: Own a component or small feature end-to-end.
  • Month 2: Start taking ownership of features with support.
  • Month 3+: Ship independently with code review.
  • Youll be paired with senior developers, given real problems, and reviewed at every step.
Why Kuvaka
  • Your first real job matters. You could join a consultancy and build 50 micro-features, or join Kuvaka and build real products - products that matter, that users depend on, that move businesses.
  • Youll work alongside engineers who care about code quality and shipping. Youll see what production-grade really means. Your code this week runs in production next week.
  • Youll see AI integration, cloud infrastructure, and modern product development. You wont be building CRUD apps - youll be building components of systems that solve real problems.
  • Growth is fast. If you ship and improve, that shows.

title: Full-Stack Developer (Backend-Focused) - Python Stack
jobDescription:
Experience with relational database design and migrations. .

Experience consuming third-party APIs (payment processors,webhooks,integrations). . Redis or caching layer optimisation. . GitHub Actions or similar CI / CD pipeline experience. .

Prior experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI,Anthropic,etc.)
descriptionFromApi:
Youre building systems that power AI workflows - REST APIs that handle concurrent requests, databases that dont lose data, deployments that dont wake you up at 3 AM. You understand that backend isnt just about making things work; its about making them work reliably.

You wont be writing microservices in a vacuum. Your APIs feed mobile apps, web interfaces, and integrations. Your database decisions matter. Your deployments get reviewed. Your code runs in production, and youre the one who fixes it when it breaks.

Frontend work exists, but youre being hired because the backend is the constraint. Frontend will evolve. The API is permanent.

What You Will Do
  • Design and build REST APIs using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
  • Write efficient SQL queries, optimise indexes, and manage relational databases under load.
  • Implement secure authentication, authorisation, and role-based access control.
  • Deploy backend services using Docker and containerised workflows.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
  • Debug production issues and ship fixes with minimal ceremony.
  • Collaborate closely with frontend teams on API contracts and data flow.
  • Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews.
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.
What We Are Looking For
  • 1+ years of production experience with Python and Django - non-negotiable.
  • Demonstrable experience building and shipping REST APIs with Django REST Framework.
  • Strong SQL fundamentals: write efficient queries, understand indexes, optimise slow queries.
  • Direct experience deploying production code and debugging issues in production.
  • Git workflow and ability to write clean, reviewable code.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorisation, and basic security patterns.
Good to Have
  • PostgreSQL experience (we use Postgres, not MySQL).
  • Docker containerisation for local development or deployment.
  • Basic AWS knowledge (EC2, RDS, or similar).
  • Experience with relational database design and migrations.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous task queues (Celery or similar).
  • Previous work on multi-user or multi-tenant systems.
  • Experience consuming third-party APIs (payment processors, webhooks, integrations).
  • Redis or caching layer optimisation.
  • GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD pipeline experience.
  • Prior experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
What You Will Work On
  • Python (3.8+) with Django and Django REST Framework.
  • PostgreSQL as the primary database, Redis for caching and task queues.
  • React.js on the frontend - you own the API contract, not the UI.
  • AWS infrastructure: EC2, ECS, RDS.
  • Docker for containerised deployments, GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
  • Celery for background job processing.
Why Kuvaka
  • Your code runs in production, not in staging. The APIs you build power healthcare applications, manufacturing workflows, and enterprise platforms - real users, real uptime requirements, real stakes.
  • You work with senior engineers who care about architecture and code quality. You get exposure to AI integration, cloud infrastructure, and working across multiple verticals in one role.
  • Growth is tied to shipping, not time served.

title: Chief of Staff
jobDescription:
Background/ About Gati:

The world is facing a severe labor shortage. High-income countries are projected to experience a cumulative workforce gap of 40-50 million people by 2030, expanding to 120-160 million by 2040. This shortfall spans several sectors, including healthcare, education, and industrial labor.

Meanwhile, Indias migrants are one of its biggest exports, generating $125 billion in remittances annually equivalent to 3% of Indias GDP. This figure surpasses any single sector of Indias merchandise exports. Yet, while migrants constitute about 1.3% of Indias population, this is substantially lower than other developing countries like Mexico, the Philippines, or Bangladesh, signaling untapped potential. The developmental impact of remittances is also higher than that of an equivalent amount in goods exports. A study reveals that a 10% rise in remittances reduces poverty by 3.5%, highlighting the potential for economic upliftment through strategic migration.

This presents India with a unique opportunity to leverage its demographic advantage and position itself as a trusted migration partner while boosting remittances and enhancing its economic standing. However, structural barriers including visa restrictions, limited employer awareness, accreditation hurdles, and financial constraints pose challenges for both workers and host countries. Addressing these barriers is key to unlocking Indias full potential in global workforce mobility.

Way of Work:

GATI Foundation is a non-profit dedicated to advancing global labor mobility and positioning India as a leader in skilled overseas employment through ethical and structured circular migration while empowering local talent. We are dedicated to solving the structural barriers in overseas migration by serving as an ecosystem enabler bringing together governments, businesses, and nonprofits to create an enabling environment for circular migration.

Our priority areas include developing high-impact migration corridors, aligning accreditation of prospective Indian workers to global standards for key job roles and destinations, unlocking financial support for workers, and strengthening worker welfare and protection. By facilitating international migration pathways through strategic public-private partnerships, GATI aims to enable seamless and responsible migration, driving both individual prosperity and national economic growth.

Roles Summary:

The Chief of Staff will go beyond traditional responsibilities to play a strategic and operational partner role. You will be responsible for enabling the CEO to maximize impact, ensuring organizational priorities are executed effectively, and representing the CEOs office with key stakeholders.

While calendar and scheduling responsibilities will form a small portion of the role (1015%), the primary focus will be on driving strategic initiatives, managing projects, supporting partnerships, and stepping in for the CEO when needed. This is a unique opportunity to work closely with the CEO of a mission-driven organization and contribute directly to building Gatis impact from the ground up.

If you are someone who is passionate about building livelihoods and creating opportunities for everyone

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Support Decision-Making

  • Act as a thought partner to the CEO, providing research, analysis, and recommendations on migration, ecosystem-building, and organizational strategy.
  • Translate the CEOs vision into actionable priorities, ensuring smooth execution across the team and with partners.
  • Track progress on key initiatives, flag bottlenecks, and ensure accountability.
  • Represent the CEO in internal discussions as needed.

2. Stakeholder Donor Engagement

  • Serve as a key point of contact for the CEO with internal teams, government officials, donors, and external partners.
  • Develop compelling presentations, reports, and proposals for funders and stakeholders.
  • Support donor engagement by preparing materials and tracking commitments.

3. Project Program Management

  • Lead and support cross-functional initiatives such as migration corridor pilots, accreditation programs, or financing models.
  • Conduct research on international labor market trends and policy developments.
  • Coordinate execution of strategic projects across the small, fast-moving team.

4. CEO Office Operations (1015%)

  • Manage the CEOs calendar, schedule meetings, and coordinate logistics as required.
  • Draft high-quality communication (emails, briefs, notes) on behalf of the CEO.
  • Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

5. Organizational Culture Team Support

  • Support the CEO in fostering a strong, values-driven, and high-performance organizational culture.
  • Coordinate team meetings, events, and offsites.

Required Qualifications, Skills Abilities

1. Bachelors degree with 3-6 years of experience in consulting, business management or administration. Experience in early-stage organizations or social impact is a plus.

2. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills along with project management and operations experience.

3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with ability to draft high-quality reports and presentations.

4. Confidence in engaging with senior stakeholders, including government officials and donors.

5. Strong project management skills; ability to prioritize and manage multiple streams of work.

6. Tech-savvy; comfortable with Google Suite, MS Office, and digital collaboration tools; familiarity with AI productivity tools is a plus.

7. Entrepreneurial, adaptable, and solution-oriented, with comfort in ambiguity and ownership of outcomes.

Location

New Delhi or Bangalore

jobDescription:
Senior Full Stack Engineer Cloud & AI Applications

Job Family: Digital / Software Engineering
Location: Navi Mumbai

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong foundations in front end development, cloud engineering, data pipelines, and modern software architecture , and a growing or established focus on AI-enabled applications .

This role spans frontend development, backend systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations. You will design and build secure, scalable digital products that leverage modern cloud platforms and AI/ML capabilities to drive intelligent workflows and user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

1. Full Stack Application Development

  • Design and build scalable web applications using React with strong HTML/CSS fundamentals .

  • Develop and maintain robust backend services using Node.js (TypeScript) or Python .

  • Design and manage RESTful APIs , including lifecycle management and versioning.

  • Implement reliability patterns such as idempotency, retries, structured error handling , and resilient service communication.

  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and data teams to deliver high-quality user-facing features.

2. Cloud-native Software Engineering (AWS / Azure)

  • Design, deploy, and operate applications on AWS or Azure .

  • Build and manage container-based platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) .

  • Work with compute, storage, database services, networking, and traffic management.

  • Implement IAM and least-privilege access control .

  • Define and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) .

  • Own CI/CD pipelines , including multi-environment promotion (dev/QA/prod), rollback strategies, and production safeguards.

3. Software Engineering for AI

  • Design and operate scalable data pipelines using Databricks or Python-based ETL frameworks .

  • Work with PostgreSQL/SQL databases , NoSQL systems, and modern lakehouse architectures.

  • Integrate AI/ML services into applications (LLM-based services, embeddings, inference APIs).

  • Build systems that support near-real-time data ingestion for AI-enabled workflows.

  • Collaborate on AI system observability, evaluation, and monitoring in production environments.

4. Frontend & UI/UX

  • Advanced UI architecture patterns (micro-frontends, design systems).

  • Strong UX sensibility and experience working closely with product/design teams.

  • Performance optimization and frontend observability.

  • Experience building AI-driven UI components (chat interfaces, dynamic workflows).

5. Security, Governance & Operational Excellence

  • Apply security-by-design and zero-trust architecture principles across cloud and APIs.

  • Implement OAuth2 / JWT-based authentication and authorization .

  • Ensure safe API exposure and external system integration.

  • Contribute to monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.

  • Make reliability, performance, and cost-aware engineering decisions.

6. Engineering Practices & Collaboration

  • Follow structured Git workflows and strong documentation practices.

  • Use agentic AI-supported coding tools responsibly to improve delivery quality.

  • Communicate clearly with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • (Lead) Define engineering standards and mentor junior engineers.

  • (Lead) Drive architectural alignment across frontend, backend, cloud, and AI components.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as a Full Stack Engineer in production environments.

  • Expertise in React , modern JavaScript/TypeScript, and UI integration.

  • Strong backend development experience (Node.js/TypeScript or Python).

  • Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure , Docker, and CI/CD.

  • Experience designing secure, scalable APIs with OAuth2/JWT.

  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, IAM, and secure architecture .

  • Experience working with structured data systems (PostgreSQL/SQL).

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset.

Good to Have (Preferred Capabilities)

A. Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Deep Kubernetes expertise and production-grade cluster operations.

  • Advanced Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / Bicep / CloudFormation).

  • Experience with secrets management and network isolation strategies.

  • Cost optimization and performance tuning in cloud-native environments.

  • Experience operating distributed systems at scale.

C. AI / ML & Agentic Systems

  • Experience building or integrating LLM-based applications .

  • Knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases .

  • Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen .

  • Familiarity with Databricks-based ML pipelines .

  • Understanding of MLOps / LLMOps , model lifecycle management, and observability.

  • Experience designing multi-agent or agentic workflows .

  • NLP or language-centric AI experience.

Who You Are

  • You combine strong software engineering fundamentals with modern cloud capabilities.

  • You are comfortable moving between frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI integration.

  • You think in systems, not just features.

  • You take ownership from design to production.

You are pragmatic and and able to make sound architectural trade-offs.

jobDescription:
Quality assurance tester
The quality assurance tester helps the company to ensure its products/ software a) meet the quality standards set by the company. Supports the company for improving the quality of its products.


Functional Context
Cosmotech AI, Pvt., Ltd. Is a software company that focuses with people management software solutions such as Human Resource Management System, Health and Wellness System, Queuing, Document Tracker, Help Desk Management, etc. The company is capable of developing other software solutions as the needs of its valued clients arise. Its Systems Development Department is responsible for the design, creation and development of quality software solutions through the support of trained, developed and well managed pool of programmers and quality assurance team members for its business value creation. The company, with its on-going business expansion, is currently increasing its resources to support the product development in compliance to the increasing requirements of its current pool of clients.


Role Accountabilities
  • Thoroughly test software to ensure proper operation and freedom from defects prior to implementation.
  • Ensure that the required standards of functional and non functional features of the software are met.
  • Streamline the testing process by using automation, leveraging tools to reduce time and effort.
  • Working with deployment teams, resolving level issues for systems, coordinating on product design, and offering inputs on the testability of functional elements and product designs.
  • Validate and assess inquiries, issues or test results reported by the users (through Support Implementation Team), determine the cause of errors, recommend solutions, coordinate and endorse to appropriate IT professionals for technical resolution and/or end users for data and procedurals resolutions.
  • Regularly update, monitor and update the status of the reported issues through issue register.
  • Setting up, maintaining, and performing test automation frameworks on multiple application platforms, such as Mobile, Desktop, and Web, and building test scenarios and acceptance tests.
  • Able to understand the business requirements and create the required test cases for Web, API and mobile applications.
  • Execute the test cases and maintain the execution status and log defects for the failed test cases.
  • Investigating customer problems referred the technical support team, testing bugs, creating and managing bug reports.
  • Ensure compliance with audit and security requirements for all testing activities


Experience, Qualifications and Skills
Minimum Experience, Essential Knowledge Skills:
  • Minimum 2 years of Software QA experience.
  • Experience in Agile frameworks and regression testing desired.
  • High attention to detail and solid analytical skills.
  • Proficient in test management software.
  • Knowledge of programming languages.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytic problem solving skills for root cause determination fixing issues.
  • Automated testing experience, preferably in Selenium.
  • Should have testing experience in cloud-based applications.
  • Strong understanding of Quality Assurance processes and methodologies.
  • Excellent English communication skills
Academic Qualifications:
  • BCA in any specialization, B.Sc in Computers, B.Tech/B.E. in Computers.
  • MCA is an advantage

descriptionFromApi:
About Marvell
Marvell s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
Your Team, Your Impact
Marvell is a leading provider of innovative storage technologies, including ultra-fast read channels, high-performance processors, leading edge transceivers, highly efficient analog designs, and powerful cryptographic engines. These solutions address all segments of the hard disk drive (HDD) and solid-state drive (SSD) electronics markets, providing complete solutions including controllers, product firmware, and reference board designs. Many of the same technologies have been utilized in Marvell storage system solutions products, powering PCs, servers, cloud, and enterprise systems.

This team that is based out of Hyderabad/Bangalore is looking for talented, self driven and motivated hands-on engineer to work on developing software for Marvells Octeon series of silicons. Scope of the work involves developing device drivers, work with hardware team in defining new silicon architecture / features, work with marketing team in addressing customer reported issues.
What You Can Expect
  • Develop and maintain Linux kernel device drivers with a focus on networking (netdev) subsystems.
  • Contribute to the Linux kernel upstreaming process, including patch preparation, submission, and community interaction.
  • Participate in root cause analysis and provide timely fixes for customer and internal issues.
  • Analyze kernel networking driver performance and optimize driver behavior for latency, throughput, and scalability.
What Were Looking For
  • Good experience in Linux kernel device driver development.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux kernel networking (netdev) driver development.
  • Familiarity with the linux kernel upstreaming process is a plus.
  • Familiar with PCIe concepts, SRIOV capability, knowledge of Linux PCIe subsystem.
  • Should have basic understanding of Linux kernel memory management, synchronisation techniques, interrupts handling and IOMMU concepts.
  • Strong programming skills in C.
  • Good problem-solving, debugging and documentation skills.
  • Bachelor s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering or related fields and 3-5 years of related professional experience.
    Master s degree and/or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related fields with 2 years of experience.
Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements
With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
Interview Integrity
To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

We work in collaborative, cross-functional squads made up of a Squad Lead, Business Analyst, Development Lead, Developers, and Quality Engineers. This structure promotes strong communication, shared ownership, and faster delivery by aligning everyone on common goals and tasks.

This is a position in Quality Assurance responsible for developing and executing performance and automation tests. This position plans and executes effective and efficient performance and automation testing to accomplish on-time and efficient delivery of high-quality software products and/or data

  • Collaborate with Developers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and QA team members to complete testing deliverables.

  • Analyze test results, provide feedback, recommend improvements, and support issue resolution to meet quality and delivery goals.

Requirement:

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing across both frontend and backend applications.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in test automation, preferably using Playwright and TypeScript.

  • 5+ years of experience in API test automation and validation.

  • Strong experience in designing and implementing scalable test automation frameworks.

  • Proven experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps integration practices.

  • Hands-on experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber.

  • Strong database testing skills, including writing and executing SQL queries.

  • Experience using AI-powered development and testing tools such as GitHub Copilot.

Minimum 4 years of professional experience building and running production automations or software, with Python at the center of your work.

Must-Have Skills

  • Python (required): strong core Python (data structures, OOP, exception handling), clean modular code, virtual environments and dependency management (pip / poetry / uv), HTTP and API work (requests / httpx), parsing JSON, CSV, and Excel data, logging, and writing tests.

  • Git and CI/CD: Azure DevOps pipelines, PR workflow, and branching.

:"

Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems . While that is the vision, the mission to build safety aware autonomous system in the extreme near term. Our research work spans around areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI, Eurips etc. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai remote), Paris, London.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.


The Role

Most of the variance in agent performance comes from the system around the model, not the model itself. This role researches that system. The coding agent is the primary testbed: it takes an objective, works on a repository, verifies its own changes, and produces a record of what it did. It runs inside a customers network, usually with no internet egress, against codebases that are large, old, thinly tested and load-bearing. Small models under real latency and cost budgets are a target, not a fallback.

Three areas:

Harness. Action space and tool surface design, context construction policy, where deterministic program analysis should replace model inference, control topology (single loop versus decomposition), verification design, and allocation of inference-time compute.

Memory. Schemas for execution state held outside the context window, compaction policy and what it destroys, retrieval under closed-world constraints, and whether an agent measurably improves on a repository over time.

Evals. Task construction from real repository history with executable verification, scoring partially-checkable long-horizon work, variance and contamination control, and failure taxonomies that attribute a failure to a component.

The work is controlled experiments on architecture, not prompt tuning: isolate a failure from eval traces, form a hypothesis about the responsible component, change it, ablate it, and establish whether the gain holds across repositories and model sizes. Outputs are papers, benchmarks and released tooling where we can publish, and shipped architecture where we cannot.

You will work directly with our alignment and interpretability researchers on post-training, behavioral evaluation, and reading what an agent actually did rather than what its trace claims.

What We Are Looking For

Research judgment with systems depth. You should be able to isolate a failure, design the experiment that tests your explanation of it, build what the experiment needs, and tell the difference between a real gain and an artifact of your setup.

Agentic systems. Two or more years building agents that ran against real workloads, not demos. Working knowledge of the current landscape (ReAct-style agents, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, the current generation of coding agents) and a specific account of where each stops working. Experience with tool-use protocols and orchestration under partial failure, retries, timeouts and non-idempotent actions.

Evaluation. You have built an eval dataset or harness that other people then used. Comfortable with SWE-bench-class benchmarks and their construction, containerised task execution at scale, statistical treatment of noisy multi-run results, and pass@k, best-of-N and majority-vote scoring and their failure cases.

Code intelligence and program analysis. ASTs and tree-sitter, static and dataflow analysis, symbol indexing and code search, call graph and dependency resolution, codemods and automated migration tooling. You should be able to build a repository-scale index and defend its design.

Backend and infrastructure. Advanced Python. Sandboxing and containerisation (Docker, gVisor, Firecracker or equivalent), distributed execution of thousands of parallel trials, artifact and dependency management, and on-premise or air-gapped deployment. Experiments that cannot be run at volume are not useful here.

Observability. Distributed tracing, structured logging, OpenTelemetry, and the replay and inspection tooling that makes a non-deterministic system debuggable end to end.

Model side. You do not need to be a training specialist, but you should be fluent in post-training methods (SFT, DPO, RL for agents), distillation, inference-time scaling, and quantisation and serving trade-offs at small parameter counts. You should have a view on where architecture ends and the model begins.

You treat performance, reliability, cost, safety and interpretability as one connected set of constraints, and you make reasonable calls when the problem is loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.

Qualifications
  • Five or more years in research engineering, systems, or ML infrastructure, with at least two on agentic or LLM-based systems. A PhD in ML, PL, systems or a related field counts toward this, as does equivalent industrial research work.
  • A public record we can read: first-author publications at ML or systems venues, a maintained open-source project, a benchmark, or a substantial technical writeup. We weigh a well-argued repository as heavily as a paper.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a system from design through production behavior.

Useful but not required: developer tooling or IDE internals, language servers and LSP, refactoring engines, compiler work, large monorepo or legacy modernisation programs, RL infrastructure, and alignment, interpretability or safety tooling in production.

We publish. We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric

PERxCEPT is a one-stop shop for omnichannel intelligence in the life sciences industry, providing visibility into every digital campaign in a market from the customer's point of view. pride in doing high-quality work

camaraderie of working with smart, grounded peers

Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM administration and reporting.

Analytical mindset with strong business acumen.
High level of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
Passion for improving processes through automation and technology.
Ability to collaborate effectively across Marketing, Sales, and Operations teams.

  • Physical ability to access equipment rooms, rooftops, and confined spaces
  • Exposure to mechanical equipment, electrical panels, and varying environmental conditions

  • Certification in HVAC systems, electrical safety, or building operations
  • Experience with energy management and sustainability initiatives
  • Knowledge of facility management software and CMMS platforms

Background/ About Gati:

The world is facing a severe labor shortage. High-income countries are projected to experience a cumulative workforce gap of 40-50 million people by 2030, expanding to 120-160 million by 2040. This shortfall spans several sectors, including healthcare, education, and industrial labor.

Meanwhile, Indias migrants are one of its biggest exports, generating $125 billion in remittances annually equivalent to 3% of Indias GDP. This figure surpasses any single sector of Indias merchandise exports. Yet, while migrants constitute about 1.3% of Indias population, this is substantially lower than other developing countries like Mexico, the Philippines, or Bangladesh, signaling untapped potential. The developmental impact of remittances is also higher than that of an equivalent amount in goods exports. A study reveals that a 10% rise in remittances reduces poverty by 3.5%, highlighting the potential for economic upliftment through strategic migration.

This presents India with a unique opportunity to leverage its demographic advantage and position itself as a trusted migration partner while boosting remittances and enhancing its economic standing. However, structural barriers including visa restrictions, limited employer awareness, accreditation hurdles, and financial constraints pose challenges for both workers and host countries. Addressing these barriers is key to unlocking Indias full potential in global workforce mobility.

Way of Work:

GATI Foundation is a non-profit dedicated to advancing global labor mobility and positioning India as a leader in skilled overseas employment through ethical and structured circular migration while empowering local talent. We are dedicated to solving the structural barriers in overseas migration by serving as an ecosystem enabler bringing together governments, businesses, and nonprofits to create an enabling environment for circular migration.

Our priority areas include developing high-impact migration corridors, aligning accreditation of prospective Indian workers to global standards for key job roles and destinations, unlocking financial support for workers, and strengthening worker welfare and protection. By facilitating international migration pathways through strategic public-private partnerships, GATI aims to enable seamless and responsible migration, driving both individual prosperity and national economic growth.

The world is facing a severe labor shortage. High-income countries are projected to experience a cumulative workforce gap of 40-50 million people by 2030, expanding to 120-160 million by 2040. This shortfall spans several sectors, including healthcare, education, and industrial labor.

Meanwhile, Indias migrants are one of its biggest exports, generating $125 billion in remittances annually equivalent to 3% of Indias GDP. This figure surpasses any single sector of Indias merchandise exports. Yet, while migrants constitute about 1.3% of Indias population, this is substantially lower than other developing countries like Mexico, the Philippines, or Bangladesh, signaling untapped potential. The developmental impact of remittances is also higher than that of an equivalent amount in goods exports. A study reveals that a 10% rise in remittances reduces poverty by 3.5%, highlighting the potential for economic upliftment through strategic migration.

This presents India with a unique opportunity to leverage its demographic advantage and position itself as a trusted migration partner while boosting remittances and enhancing its economic standing. However, structural barriers including visa restrictions, limited employer awareness, accreditation hurdles, and financial constraints pose challenges for both workers and host countries. Addressing these barriers is key to unlocking Indias full potential in global workforce mobility.

Way of Work:

GATI Foundation is a non-profit dedicated to advancing global labor mobility and positioning India as a leader in skilled overseas employment through ethical and structured circular migration while empowering local talent. We are dedicated to solving the structural barriers in overseas migration by serving as an ecosystem enabler bringing together governments, businesses, and nonprofits to create an enabling environment for circular migration.

Our priority areas include developing high-impact migration corridors, aligning accreditation of prospective Indian workers to global standards for key job roles and destinations, unlocking financial support for workers, and strengthening worker welfare and protection. By facilitating international migration pathways through strategic public-private partnerships, GATI aims to enable seamless and responsible migration, driving both individual prosperity and national economic growth.

Roles Summary:

The Chief of Staff will go beyond traditional responsibilities to play a strategic and operational partner role. You will be responsible for enabling the CEO to maximize impact, ensuring organizational priorities are executed effectively, and representing the CEOs office with key stakeholders.

While calendar and scheduling responsibilities will form a small portion of the role (1015%), the primary focus will be on driving strategic initiatives, managing projects, supporting partnerships, and stepping in for the CEO when needed. This is a unique opportunity to work closely with the CEO of a mission-driven organization and contribute directly to building Gatis impact from the ground up.

If you are someone who is passionate about building livelihoods and creating opportunities for everyone

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Support Decision-Making

As one of the world s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. descriptionFromApi:
ERM is the world s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.

Our Consulting Delivery Hub (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.

As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.

Why this role matters

As a Construction Health Safety Specialist, you will support ERM s global consulting delivery by providing construction-focused HS expertise that helps clients and project teams manage higher-risk works safely and in compliance with legislation and standards. Working within the Safety Sustainable Operations (SSO) service line of the Consulting Delivery Hub - and partnering with regional consultants, designers, contractors and client HS representatives across EMEA, SEBU and North America - you will, as a developing specialist working with minimal supervision, independently deliver and review the construction-safety documentation and analysis that underpins safe execution on site. This role is critical to preventing incidents on dynamic construction projects, strengthening contractor performance, and enabling ERM to scale trusted, high-quality construction HS delivery from the hub.


What your impact is

  • Construction HS deliverables - RAMS, method statements, JSAs, hazard registers, safety plans and CDM / pre-construction information - are produced and reviewed independently to a standard regional teams can rely on with minimal rework.

  • Higher-risk construction activities (work at height, lifting, excavation, confined space, hot work) are competently risk-assessed and controls are verified against design, method and legislation.

  • Contractor HS plans, method statements and corrective-action evidence are reviewed rigorously, driving measurable improvement in contractor compliance.

  • Incident and near-miss investigations are well supported through sound root-cause analysis, with preventive actions that reduce recurrence across projects.

  • Regional project teams gain reliable, judgement-based construction HS capacity from the hub, improving delivery quality, consistency and speed.

  • As a developing specialist, you will mentor junior colleagues and raise the technical bar of the wider HSE delivery team.

What will you bring

  • A bachelor s or master s degree in Occupational Health Safety, Environmental/Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Typically, 3-5 years of HS experience, including meaningful exposure to construction or infrastructure projects (a relevant masters may offset some experience).

  • Sound working knowledge of construction HS - CDM 2015 (or equivalent), safe systems of work, permit-to-work, and control of high-risk activities (work at height, lifting, excavation, confined space, hot work).

  • Practical experience preparing and reviewing RAMS, method statements, JSAs, hazard registers and safety documentation.

  • Familiarity with ISO 45001 management systems and applicable construction HS legislation/standards across international jurisdictions (EMEA/UK, US/OSHA and others).

  • Experience supporting incident investigation and root-cause analysis and reviewing contractor HS performance.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, exercise technical judgement and manage priorities across multiple projects and time zones.

  • Confident written and verbal English communication and stakeholder engagement with contractors, engineers and client HS contacts.

  • A recognized construction-safety qualification - NEBOSH Certificate in Construction Health Safety (Health Safety Management for Construction) or equivalent - held or in progress.

  • NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC) or equivalent - held.

Preferred qualifications, skills competencies

  • NEBOSH International Diploma (held or working toward).

  • ISO 45001:2018 Lead Auditor.

  • CertIOSH / CMIOSH (or actively progressing); BCSP ASP/CSP.

  • CDM / Safety-in-Design training; IEMA membership; ISO 14001 Lead Auditor.

  • Experience with CDM / Safety-in-Design (SiD) advisory and design-stage risk management using the hierarchy of controls.

  • Exposure to occupational-health risk (noise, dust, hazardous substances, asbestos) and/or ESG / sustainability integration.

  • Experience in a global delivery or consulting environment supporting multi-region project portfolios.

  • Use of automation or AI-enabled tools to improve HSE analysis, review and reporting.

Key responsibilities

  • Independently prepare and review construction HS deliverables - RAMS, method statements, JSAs, hazard registers, construction-phase plans, CDM / pre-construction information and safety files - to ERM and client standards.

  • Assess higher-risk construction activities (work at height, lifting, excavation, confined space, hot work) and verify that controls align with the hierarchy of controls, design intent, method statements and legislation.

  • Review contractor HS plans, method statements and corrective-action evidence, monitor contractor compliance, and escalate gaps with practical recommendations.

  • Support and document incident and near-miss investigations using root-cause analysis, and track preventive/corrective actions to closure across projects.

  • Provide technical HS advice to regional consultants, designers, contractors and client representatives on compliance obligations, risk-control strategies and safe systems of work.

  • Develop and review construction-safety documentation, inductions, toolbox talks and site-specific briefings that regional teams deliver on site.

  • Support desktop verification of site findings, safety walk-through outcomes and inspection close-outs reported by regional/site teams.

  • Contribute to HSE management-system implementation and audit-readiness (ISO 45001) and apply ERM methodologies, tools and safety standards published on Minerva.

  • Act as a buddy / mentor to junior HSE Specialists, supporting their technical development and reviewing their outputs.

title: Senior Incident Response Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Incident Response Consultant to join our Incident Response (IR) service. The Sophos IR team is an elite group of incident responders that are engaged by organizations worldwide to respond to and neutralize cyber threats. Specializing in industry-standard forensic tools and Sophos technologies, the team provides comprehensive investigations, response actions, remediation guidance, and root cause analysis to combat a wide range of cybersecurity incidents.

As a Senior Incident Response Consultant on the Sophos IR team, you will be responsible for spearheading incident response engagements for customers who have experienced a cybersecurity attack. In this role, you will lead a team of Incident Response Consultants, running customer-facing calls, providing detailed written updates via email, and determining the priorities of the investigation, delegating tasks accordingly to your team.

In this role, you will be accountable for ensuring that the appropriate actions have been taken by both your team and the customer to effectively neutralize the threat. Additionally, you will be tasked with conducting a thorough root cause analysis to determine the origin of the incident, including identifying whether any data exfiltration occurred, provided the necessary evidence is available.

At the culmination of each engagement, you will be responsible for producing an executive summary-style report, which will include a timeline of key events mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. This comprehensive report will serve as a valuable resource for stakeholders, highlighting the steps taken to combat the cybersecurity incident and provide remediation guidance.

The ideal candidate for this role will possess extensive experience leading incident response efforts, a deep understanding of cybersecurity threats and mitigation strategies, and the ability to communicate complex technical information to executive-level stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

What you will do

  • Lead kick off calls with customers to understand their situation and identify initial response actions to contain the threat
  • Provide guidance to customers on best practices following an incident
  • Lead daily update calls for customers to deliver forensic findings
  • Deliver concise email updates to customers between update calls
  • Direct the forensic investigations, identify priorities, and delegate tasks to analysts
  • Conduct multiple Rapid Response incidents concurrently
  • Determine TTPs identified by analysts and add them to the threat intel platform
  • Write clear and concise Executive Summary style reports in a timely manner
  • Responsible for basic to moderate complexity projects that contribute to the development of the Sophos Rapid Response service
  • Provide daily handover notes to teams located in different time zones, or when incident responsibility is being transferred to another Incident Lead

What you will bring

  • 5+ years of experience leading incident response investigations involving ransomware
  • Experience leading BEC investigations
  • Continuously learning and staying informed of the changing threat landscape
  • Proven track record of successful neutralization and remediation of ransomware threats
  • Excellent understanding of the Incident Response process
  • Excellent understanding of cyber risks and able to qualify them to customers
  • Excellent oral communication skills
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Ability to manage time effectively
  • Able to delegate and prioritize tasks across multiple incidents
  • Able to excel under stressful circumstances
  • Occasionally willing to begin work early and/or stay late when warranted for customer engagements
  • Strong grasp of the MITRE ATT&CK framework
  • Enjoy mentoring and assisting in the development of junior analysts
  • A team-player attitude with a willingness to share knowledge
  • Ability to work on weekends and holidays
  • Post-secondary education in Cybersecurity, comparable
  • Desirable: Cybersecurity certifications an asset (e.g. CISSP, GCFA, or similar)
  • Experience with SIEM technology (e.g. Splunk, ELK, etc.)
  • Willingness to work occasional overtime during peak times or holidays
  • Experience writing SQL queries
  • Experience writing PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripts

You will be working with a team of passionate and skilled engineers across NVIDIA that are continuously working to provide better tools to build and manage this infrastructure. descriptionFromApi:
AI Engineers with 3 5 years of relevant experience in Generative AI
You ll need to be a hands-on problem-solver at the intersection of software engineering and AI. This role requires deep technical curiosity, experience with modern LLM stacks, and a strong grasp of foundational AI concepts, as well as advanced prompt engineering practices.
What you ll do:
  • Build Advanced AI Agents: Move beyond simple chains to develop complex, multi-step AI agents that can reason, plan, and execute tasks. You ll become an expert in advanced architectural patterns, orchestrating both deterministic and non-deterministic workflows, and exploring techniques like reinforcement learning to refine agent policies.
  • Implement Deep Tool & API Integration: Equip agents with the ability to perform real-world actions by implementing Tool Calling and MCPs, and integrating them with a diverse set of internal and external tools, databases, and APIs.
  • Master Systematic Prompt Engineering: Design sophisticated prompt chains using techniques like Chain-of-Thought and ReAct, and build systems to test, version, and manage these prompts like code.
  • Drive Rigorous Evaluation & Experimentation: Develop automated evaluation suites to benchmark agent performance on metrics like correctness, relevance, and safety, driving continuous improvement through data-driven A/B testing.
  • Implement Safety & Guardrails: Build critical safety layers and validation steps to ensure agents operate reliably and prevent them from taking unintended, incorrect, or harmful actions.
  • Own AI System Observability & Optimization: Implement comprehensive logging, metrics, and tracing to monitor AI systems in production. Manage the trade-offs between performance, latency, and cost by implementing techniques like multi-LLM routing and advanced caching.
  • Lead Enterprise-Scale System Ownership: Take true ownership of production AI components, ensuring their security, reliability, and scalability as part of our robust microservices architecture.
What you should have:
Core AI & Software Fundamentals
  • Solid Python Proficiency: Expertise in Python and its ecosystem, including libraries like NumPy and Pandas.
  • Machine Learning & Deep Learning Concepts: Have a solid grasp of the machine learning landscape, including common model types and when to apply them. You should be proficient in at least one major ML framework like PyTorch or TensorFlow .
  • Data Processing & Refinement: Have practical experience with the day-to-day work of cleaning, preprocessing, and transforming structured and unstructured data to make it suitable for AI models.
  • Broad AI Application Knowledge: Understand the principles behind a range of modern AI applications, such as semantic search, text summarization, chatbots, data extraction from unstructured text, and computer vision tasks like image analysis and object detection.
  • API Development Experience: Have hands-on experience building, testing, and deploying RESTful APIs .
Core Generative AI Proficiency
  • Prompt Engineering: Context Engineering: Understand the critical practice of strategically managing the information provided in an LLM s context window. You understand and have practised the fundamentals of crafting effective prompts to guide and steer LLM behaviour. This includes using patterns like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), managing conversational history, and providing effective few-shot examples to ground the model and improve response quality.
  • Understanding of LLMs and the Ecosystem: Have a strong grasp of how Large Language Models work, their capabilities, and their limitations. You are familiar with the Hugging Face ecosystem.
  • Hands-on Experience with LLM Frameworks: Have built projects using modern LLM application frameworks (e.g., LangChain , LlamaIndex ).
  • Knowledge of Fine-Tuning: Understand the concepts and use cases for adapting models to specific domains through fine-tuning.
  • Production Deployment of GenAI (nice to have): Have some experience deploying Generative AI solutions to a production environment and understand the unique considerations involved, such as managing latency, optimizing costs, ensuring security, and monitoring for performance degradation or model drift.
What would be great to have:
  • Strong Problem-Solving Mindset: You are naturally curious and adept at breaking down complex, ambiguous problems into manageable steps.
  • Clear Communication: You can articulate technical concepts and decisions clearly to your peers.
What we offer:
  • Competitive salary with performance-linked bonus
  • A competitive salary and performance bonus.
  • Comprehensive health insurance.
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model.
  • A budget for professional development, conferences, and certifications.
  • The opportunity to work on diverse AI projects in a company with a 15+ year history of excellence.

jobDescription:

descriptionFromApi:
About the Role
Auric AI Labs is developing the worlds most advanced AI-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications. We are building an AI-native intelligence system from scratch. No legacy DSP pipeline, no AI-as-classifier-stage, no hybrid compromises. We need an engineer to build the deep learning models that detect, classify, geolocate, and fingerprint radar and communications emitters directly from raw IQ data.
Why this role exists
Most AI in SIGINT today is AI bolted onto a 1990s DSP pipeline as a final classification stage. Filter, threshold, extract feature, then hand the leftovers to a small neural network. Each stage before the network throws away information the network could have used. Each hand-crafted feature is a prior the model is forced to inherit.
We are not doing that.
We are betting that an AI-native architecture, where deep learning operates on raw IQ data with minimal pre-processing, learns its own features, and replaces the deterministic stack rather than supplementing it, delivers a 5-10x improvement on every metric that matters: detection in low SNR, classification of unknown waveforms, specific emitter ID, real-time anomaly detection, cognitive EW.
This is not an AI feature inside a conventional product. The model is the product.
The actual problems
  • The signals are designed to defeat you: A modern LPI radar deliberately spreads its energy below the noise floor. A frequency-agile emitter changes frequency every pulse. Your job is to find structure that has been deliberately hidden.
  • You will not have real training data: Zero, for the signals that matter most. Before you can train a model, you have to answer a harder question: what does it mean for a model trained entirely in simulation to be trustworthy in the real worldYou will design the synthetic data pipeline, the channel models, the validation methodology, and the test for knowing when your simulator is wrong.
  • Every emitter is unique: Two radars of the same model number have hardware differences (oscillator drift, amplifier non-linearities, timing jitter) that fingerprint them individually. The problem is not which class of radar, it is have I seen this specific transmitter before, even in a different mode, even years ago. Open-set, fine-grained, unlabelled.
  • The DSP world will tell you it cannot be done: Some of their reasons are right. You will need to engage with them honestly, then figure out which ones are wrong and why.
Who we are looking for
Not a list of traits, those describe nothing. Specific, observable things we will recognise when we see them:
  • AI-native instinct: Your first instinct on a new problem is not what filter, transform, or heuristic applies here but what should a learned function take in, what should it output, and what is the right inductive bias. You think in terms of data, loss, and architecture the way a DSP engineer thinks in filter coefficients. You see hand-engineered features as priors to be questioned, not assumed.
  • You reason about whether a model fits its data: Not just whether it trains. You can look at a problem and argue, before writing code, why a particular architecture is or is not suited to the structure of the data it will see. You know that complex-valued signals, long-range temporal dependencies, and small distribution shifts each break specific assumptions, and you can name which.
  • You design experiments that can fail: Most ML work tunes until the loss goes down. Yours starts with the question: what result would prove I am wrong. You build the falsifying test before you build the model. With synthetic data and no real ground truth, this discipline is the entire difference between research that works and research that only seems to.
  • You read papers to find what the authors did not say: You reproduce a paper and notice the seed dependence the authors quietly omitted, the dataset preprocessing buried in the appendix, the hyperparameter that does most of the work. This habit is rare and it is what separates engineers who absorb a field from engineers who collect summaries of it.
  • The best work on your CV is work nobody assigned: A paper you reproduced because the result seemed too clean. A side project that became four months. An idea you kept thinking about after the class or job that introduced it had ended. The single hardest thing to fake.
  • You can turn a vague objective into a defensible ML problem: Detect this radar is not a specification. You can take an objective in plain English, decide what the inputs are, what the outputs should be, what the right loss is, and what evaluation would actually mean the system works in the field. This translation is most of the job.
